title: `merge --lane-lint` finishes on a large head inside ci-job's time cap
why: A lane cannot finish its own lint on a large head, so its verdict reads UNKNOWN.
note: Incident: on #1099, `merge --lane-lint` ended UNKNOWN at ci-job's 1200 s cap in 3 runs: 89 steps, many 74-113 s each, load about 1 on 4 CPUs (coordinator 22:33 CST Nov 9). Fix idea: split the job, or size the cap from measured step times. Related: lane-lint-cloud-time-limit (ready; measures step times, cuts suites to picked ones), lane-lint-load-timeout (ready; cap under load from other processes), lane-lint-parallel-cap (ready), lane-lint-hub-cost (todo). Check first whether those PRs, once merged, already close #1099's case.
